hypothesis: The intermediate 8192-point cycle reduces gradient noise enough to retain the dense baseline's persistent structure and error guardrails, while using one eighth of its point presentations.
prior_result: Batch 2 audited: 4096 cycling retained 5/6 persistent structural passes; local seed 33 failed at 26000 and passed at 30000. Gap RMSE ratios were 1.1997684711676977 at 26000 and 1.11778782496037 at 30000, both outside the frozen 1.10 guardrail. Training-time ratio was 0.2989593492854896 and presentation ratio 0.0625. It does not qualify despite 6/6 final structural passes. Batch 1's 16384 cycling remains the qualifying candidate.
controls: Same six 20000-update model/Adam states, exact dense pools, ordinary MSE, architecture, 10000-update cosine schedule, independent probes and unchanged 192/384 gate. Compare to audited batch-1 dense and 16384 cycling, retaining batch-2 failures. No optimizer reset, no extra training seeds, no changed loss, no altered evaluation criterion.
decision_criteria: All six trajectories must pass at both 26000 and 30000 and both resolutions; aggregate training time <=0.90 of batch-1 dense; fewer point presentations. At BOTH later checkpoints, mean Chamfer at each grid <=1.05 times dense, mean independent gap RMSE <=1.10 times dense, and mean full-gap sign accuracy no more than 0.5 percentage points below dense. Missing meshes fail. Report all seeds and checkpoints even if a criterion already fails. No relaxation after seeing results.
pairing: Eight disjoint balanced 8192-point blocks cycle through the exact 65536-point pool. Each update has 4096 original, 2048 gap and 2048 interior points. Starting model/Adam and original sampling RNG are shared by matched policy/seed; streams intentionally differ by batch size. Original independent evaluation sets remain disjoint and unused for selection.
budget: Third and final new experiment batch. Cumulative training/evaluation must remain below 7200 seconds. Entire process wall time charged with the existing hard watchdog; logs, checkpoints and partial results retained. No fourth batch, including no phase-shift experiment, under this goal.
scope: Existing development geometry and seeds only. No fresh cases evaluated. All dense labels and storage retained. Savings refer only to the additional continuation stage. Later timing comparisons reuse batch-1 dense timings and are not a controlled speed benchmark.
next_decision: Stop after this batch and its audit. If 8192 qualifies, report it as the lowest-presentation qualifying tested size, with untested order sensitivity and held-out generalisation as limitations. If it fails, retain 16384 as the best supported qualifying size. Preserve the 4096 negative result either way. Recommend a separately frozen confirmation study without consuming reserved cases now.
